message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel chart showing average performance increasing with data volume and across progressively richer LLM judge configurations.","description":"The target is a two-panel chart. Panel (a), marked “(a),” is a line chart with Data Volume on the x-axis and Avg@8 (%) on the y-axis. The y-axis runs from 40 to 45. A blue line with circular markers rises from 40.3 at data volume 100, to 42.7 at 200, and 44.3 at 500; each value is printed beside its marker. Panel (b), marked “(b),” is a bar chart with Judge Configuration on the x-axis and Avg@8 (%) on the y-axis, scaled from 0 to 50. Three bars rise from left to right: “Naive LLM Judge (w/o principle & ref.)” is 22.5, “Judge (w/ principle, w/o ref.)” is 33.1, and “Ours” is 44.3. The values are printed above the bars.
